correctness.rationale: The four rate functions exactly represent model-1 copy/oppose behavior. The finite irreducible chain has a bit-flip symmetry, closed degree-two generator equations, and a nonsingular solved rational moment system. For fixed r, the fast conditional generator is a birth–death chain with unique Binomial(r,1-x) invariant measure on every x including endpoints. The slow Taylor generator then gives the beta moment recurrence; uniqueness on compact [0,1] proves full joint convergence. Exact rational stationary elimination for 24 finite chains verified all means, covariance entries, and generator identities; the analytic proof, not finite enumeration, proves all sizes.

value.rationale: A permanent finite minority of contrarians is an explicitly identified difficult regime for the original Gaussian treatment. The result provides the full weak stationary marginal and conditional law for every r, gives an exact finite-population covariance for all m,r, and quantitatively connects the r=1 uniform case to increasing finite r. Its value is the mechanism and structural classification, not a small finite calculation or simple recoding.
